/**
 * @name Unsafe deserialization
 * @description Deserializing untrusted data using pickle, yaml, or marshal can lead to arbitrary code execution.
 * @kind problem
 * @problem.severity error
 * @id py/unsafe-deserialization-setuptools
 * @tags security
 *        external/cwe/cwe-502
 */

import python
import semmle.python.ApiGraphs

from DataFlow::CallCfgNode call
where
  call = API::moduleImport("pickle").getMember(["load", "loads", "Unpickler"]).getACall() or
  call = API::moduleImport("yaml").getMember(["load", "unsafe_load"]).getACall() or
  call = API::moduleImport("marshal").getMember(["load", "loads"]).getACall() or
  call = API::moduleImport("shelve").getMember("open").getACall()
select call, "Potentially unsafe deserialization operation."

/**
 * @name Archive extraction calls
 * @description Calls to tarfile/zipfile extract/extractall methods which may be vulnerable to path traversal if member names are not validated.
 * @kind problem
 * @problem.severity warning
 * @id py/archive-extraction-setuptools
 * @tags security
 *        external/cwe/cwe-022
 */

import python

from Call call, Attribute attr
where
  call.getFunc() = attr and
  attr.getName() in ["extract", "extractall"]
select call, "Archive extraction call that may be vulnerable to path traversal (zip slip)."
findings.hypothesis: Archive extraction methods used without member name sanitization (zip slip)
